# NewsOne

> > NewsOne is a leading digital news platform delivering comprehensive coverage of news, politics, criminal justice, and social issues impacting Black America.

NewsOne provides in-depth reporting on criminal justice reform, political developments, community stories, and cultural news relevant to African American communities. The platform covers major figures including Barack Obama, Viola Davis, Michael B. Jordan, Jasmine Crockett, and Kash Patel, with special focus on voting rights, government policy, and social justice issues across states including Georgia, Texas, Florida, Michigan, and Pennsylvania.

## Key Topics

- Black America news and culture
- Criminal justice and reform
- Social justice movements
- Voting rights and political advocacy
- Community stories and local news
- Government policy and accountability
- Death penalty and capital punishment
- Barack Obama and political leadership
- Viola Davis and Michael B. Jordan
- Jasmine Crockett and political opinion
- Kash Patel and FBI coverage
- Georgia, Texas, and Southern states
- Health equity and HIV/AIDS prevention
- HBCU education and Black church
- Celebrity news and entertainment

## Homepage & Core

- [News for Black America - NewsOne](https://newsone.com): Homepage for NewsOne covering Black America news, politics & social justice
